name: Janitor's Club
source:
Finally, you've made it !
After a year of hard work, you're the head and the only member of your own club. This club that you build to repulse anyone to enter it, this club that you used, bit by bit, to satisfy your unhealthy desires and curiosity.

You start to enjoy your achievement, when someone knocks on the door...

[Made entirely during a one-night contest at a French convention "Epitanime")
translation:
终于，你做到了！经过一年的努力，你是自己社团的社长和唯一成员。这个你建立来让所有人不敢靠近的社团，这个你一点一点用来满足不健康欲望和好奇心的社团。

你正沉浸在成就中享受，这时有人敲了门……

[在法国展会“Epitanime”的一夜比赛中完全制作]
